inclusions.source: This is a private, guided day tour — no shared coach, no group waiting time — suited to first-time visitors who want serious orientation without the overhead of planning it themselves, and to returning travellers who have done the plateau before and want the guide's depth on the museum.

exclusions.text: Grand Egyptian Museum (GEM) is not part of this itinerary
exclusions.source: Note: this is the old Egyptian Museum — the 1902 neo-classical building that has housed the collection for over a century — not the Grand Egyptian Museum (GEM) at Giza, which is a separate institution that opened fully on 1 November 2025 and is not part of this itinerary.
